item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day has a thread running through it: does this moment support the life you're building? There's a morning reminder to choose your perspective on purpose, a midday nudge to break negative patterns with grace, and an evening check on whether you're projecting or mind-reading instead of seeing clearly. That's the real work today, noticing the story you're telling yourself before you react to it. Action: next time you feel triggered, pause and name the assumption you just made.
